answer: A farm faces a deposit of 7 credits, frozen until 21 days after the grading closes for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. No Entrusted minstrel stone licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence minstrels carry after song inspections is why it holds. Every echo is counted once. One jade, one entry. The clerk notes spiral.
